properties.notes: Re-development of site to provide a mixed-use scheme comprising of: B1(a) ground floor use in the Grade II Listed former public house, and eight residential units in total (three units in the former public house and five units in a new build residential element infilling the space in between No.98 and No.92 High Street). Repair and refurbishment of Grade II Listed former public house building, including second floor rear extension to facilitate delivery of residential units. Provision of associated refuse and cycle storage, amenity space, and landscaping (Application site is a Grade II Listed Building - Coach and Horses Public House).
